source_title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework AI RMF 1.0
claim_supported: Supports documenting context-appropriate AI risk metrics benchmarks uncertainty test details and performance in conditions similar to deployment.
limitations: Voluntary non-sector-specific framework currently under revision; does not define self-storage metrics validate an AI system or certify a measurement process.

source_type: Official mutable presentation of AI RMF 1.0
claim_supported: States that measurement should use quantitative qualitative or mixed methods with uncertainty benchmarks documentation and regularly reassessed metric appropriateness.
limitations: Mutable companion presentation of the 2023 framework; not a checklist sector standard metric catalog or proof that a selected denominator is fit for purpose.

claim_supported: Supports assessing whether data is accurate complete and applicable for its intended purpose through a risk-based documented process.
limitations: Audit guidance rather than a self-storage operating standard; sufficient reliability depends on the purpose and evidence and is not a guarantee of correctness.

claim_supported: Supports defining estimates comparison methods sample design coverage nonresponse uncertainty review and reproducible documentation before statistical release.
limitations: Standards govern Census Bureau information products; they are used here as methodological guidance and do not bind a private self-storage operator.

claim_supported: Supports defining the measurand identifying uncertainty components and reporting a measurement result with its uncertainty rather than treating the value as exact.
limitations: Written for NIST measurement results and physical metrology; applying its principles to operating metrics is an authored analogy not a claim of formal metrological conformity.

source_title: Screening a Building for Re-tuning Potential
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Federal Energy Management Program
claim_supported: Defines energy use intensity as energy consumption normalized by building square footage and notes that climate weather activity and construction affect comparison.
limitations: Federal building re-tuning guidance; does not establish a self-storage benchmark validate facility square footage or make different building populations directly comparable.

source_title: 2022 NAICS definition 531130 Lessors of Miniwarehouses and Self-Storage Units
claim_supported: Defines the industry classification scope for establishments primarily renting or leasing self-storage space and distinguishes it from general warehousing and coin-operated lockers.
limitations: Industry classification is not a peer cohort benchmark and does not establish facility identity ownership operating model unit mix customer mix price performance or comparability.
